ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Animals ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Weather ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Water ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Soil ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain SOUND ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Smell ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
